main_body: two-story half-timbered and stone building with a hipped tile roof
top_band: sloped tile roof from row 1 to row 42
evidence: The structure clearly shows a large sloped roof surface seen from above (rows 1-42) overhanging the two-story south wall face (rows 43-106), with an eave shadow at rows 43-47 and inset windows/door.

style.evidence: The candidate is a quantized/posterized reduction of a Beodeul-style building into only 4 total palette colours. While the references use 5-6 steps per material with speckled plaster, multi-tone stone, and highlighted roof tiles, the candidate has completely flat 1-colour plaster panels (e.g. rows 48-74), dark solid window fills, and only 2-3 tones across the entire roof and stonework.
